directAnswer.en: This is a pipe trench or a short pipeline placement. Open this row when the site has no grid and must mix and pump on one machine. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Diesel Mixer Integrated at diesel 4108 / 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, stone ≤ 1 inch 100 / 300 m, 13 mm stone 60 / 180 m, 24 mm stone 40 / 120 m, 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm and 4200 kg. The series note says 30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 model with 500 mixer. Do not move the same condition onto Diesel 30, which prints diesel 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa, 60 m horizontal / 180 m vertical, aggregate 3 cm and below, hopper 0.3 m³, 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm and 2000 kg. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.

body.en: Send the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical line you measured, and the supply the printed motor needs. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job, a price or a daily volume.
body.zh: 请发送配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及已印电机需要的电源。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。

answer.en: Open this row when the site has no grid and must mix and pump on one machine.

question.en: Is the printed output a contract volume?
question.zh: 印出的输送量是合同方量吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel Mixer Integrated prints theoretical catalogue figures only. This page names no floor, no contract volume and no price.
answer.zh: 不是。柴油搅拌泵一体机只印理论目录数字。本页不写楼层、合同方量或价格。
